response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack engineering skills and recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) work. While his experience aligns well with cloud and TypeScript/Python requirements, his AI/GenAI production experience is less explicit than the role demands, and his leadership in AI-specific contexts is not clearly highlighted.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience with TypeScript and cloud platforms (AWS), directly relevant to the role's technical stack.
Recent contributions to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq, indicating familiarity with modern GenAI workflows.
Proven ability to lead technical projects and mentor teams, as evidenced by workshops, talks, and staff-level roles.
concerns: AI/GenAI production experience is not explicitly detailed for the required 8+ years, raising questions about depth in this domain.
Limited mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM performance metrics, which are critical for the role.
Customer-facing technical leadership in AI contexts is not clearly demonstrated, despite strong consulting and project management history.
